name: dependency-upgrade-node
description: Upgrade the one vulnerable npm dependency of the 'node-upgrade' fixture (minimist 1.2.5) to the version the host's advisory scan names (1.2.6): ask, plan, approve, execute, host verification in the language's own container, security gate passes. Plan granularity is not asserted.

steps.name: ask about vulnerabilities
steps.say: 这个项目的 npm 依赖有没有已知的安全漏洞？有的话告诉我该升到哪个版本。先别改代码。

steps.name: plan
steps.say: 只升级 minimist，升到你刚才说的最低修复版本，其余依赖（包括其它有公告的传递依赖）都不要动，锁文件要一起更新。给我一份正式计划（走 create_session_plan），我看过再批准，先别执行。

steps.name: approve and execute
steps.say: 计划我看过了，批准，开始执行。
